lines.text: Many learners say: The news are bad.
Is! The news is good today.

native.tip: كلمة news مفرد: نقول is: “The news is bad.” وليس “The news are bad.”.
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا “The news are bad.” 😅 كلمة news مفرد: نقول is، فالجملة الصحيحة “The news is bad.” استمع إلى Ama وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.

en.hook: Do you say “The news are bad”?
en.tip: News is singular: we say is: “The news is bad.” not “The news are bad.”.
en.caption: Do you sometimes say “The news are bad.” 😅 News is singular: we say is, so the right sentence is “The news is bad.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
